notes: «وَقَالَ صَالِحُ بْنُ اَلْحَكَمِ» opens the report with no earlier transmitter, so Salih is the first link (rule 10)
«سُئِلَ اَلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» : the Imam is the one asked and answers («صَلِّ فِيهَا»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«731 -» is the report number, left out
